title: Quarterly convergence blueprint for private-tenant feature bundles
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Objective: produce a single-quarter, delivery-oriented blueprint that groups Private/VPC/on-prem features into three customer-focused bundles aligned to sales SLAs and compliance windows. The goal is to reduce operational friction for enterprise customers onboarding private instances while keeping a clear opt-in path for Dedicated customers.

Why this is different: rather than a long linear roadmap, this ticket proposes a 'bundle' approach: bundle = minimal compatible set of features (networking, RBAC, upgrade-safety, telemetry retention) that can be shipped, validated by a pilot cohort, and used as a release unit for contractual commitments. This enables sales to promise deterministic windows while engineering ships in parallel lane.

Scope (candidate features for Q2 bundle):
- Private control plane lite (VPC peering recipes + onboarding checklist)
- Tenant-scoped RBAC MVP (roles: admin, operator, reader) + audit log export to customer KMS
- Upgrade safety gates (compatibility checker + dark-launch rollback path)
- SLO telemetry export + per-tenant cost breakdown in Console
- Base on-prem installer shrinkwrap + automated smoke test harness

Success metrics / OKR alignment:
- OKR: Reduce time-to-activation for Private customers from baseline 45 days -> 20 days for pilot cohort (key result).
- OKR: Achieve 99.5% activation success rate for first 10 pilots.
- Metric signals: onboarding time, activation success, post-activation support tickets/week, token unit costs in first 30 days.

Milestones and timeline (quarter):
- Week 1-2: Finalize bundle contents + acceptance criteria + pilot cohort signups (stakeholder review).
- Week 3-6: Engineering spikes and compatibility matrix; complete RBAC schema and API spec; provide test fixtures.
- Week 7-9: Console dashboards and telemetry export; safety gate automation (compat checker).
- Week 10-12: Pilot rollouts (3 customers), collect metrics, iterate; prepare contract SLA language.
- Week 13: Post-pilot report + go/no-go for broader wave.

Stakeholders: Product (Aisha Kapoor), Eng runtime (Marcus Chen), Eng infra (Maya Alvarez), Security & Compliance (Omar Patel), Solutions & Sales (Lina Rodriguez), DevEx (Justin Park), Design (Eve Laurent).

Acceptance criteria (minimal):
- Private control plane onboarding checklist documented in Confluence and validated by 1 pilot.
- RBAC implemented with audit logs exported to customer KMS; proof-of-concept PR merged and e2e smoke test green.
- Compatibility checker returns a deterministic pass/fail for packages in the bundle and triggers automatic rollback on failure in canary.
- Console shows per-tenant cost and SLO telemetry for pilot tenants with <1min latency to query.
- Installer runs in customer's VPC or air-gapped environment using documented steps; automated smoke tests pass on first attempt for at least 2/3 pilot runs.

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: Kernel/quantization incompatibilities across customer hardware. Mitigation: maintain a trimmed compatibility matrix and include a 'fallback model variant' in bundle.
- Risk: Upgrade rollback complexity for on-prem. Mitigation: require compatibility checker and snapshot rollback; include documented runbook.
- Risk: Sales over-promising timelines. Mitigation: lock activation SLAs to bundle-only commits and provide template contract addendum.

Cross-team coordination items (actionable):
- Eng infra to produce compatibility matrix by 2026-03-22 (ENG-4021).
- Security to sign off on KMS/audit export by 2026-04-05.
- DevEx to prepare two onboarding templates and a sample terraform module for pilot tenants by 2026-04-12.
- Solutions to recruit 3 pilot customers and validate commercial language by 2026-04-01.

Decision log: bundle approach approved in planning sync 2026-03-10 (notes linked above). The team opted for conservative scope to enable measurable pilots rather than attempting full parity with Hosted API in Q2.

Next steps: finalize pilot cohort list, confirm resource allocations with Eng leads, and prepare the pilot readiness checklist for the first gating review (planned 2026-03-22).
